parsed.post: Significant improvement found by increasing DEPTH from 4 to 8 (val_bpb 1.035777). Capacity boost seems highly effective within the 5-minute budget. Next, I will attempt to optimize the learning rate and introduce weight decay to see if we can further refine the training stability and convergence.
parsed.description: Refining the new 8-depth architecture by slightly lowering the learning rate and adding weight decay to improve generalization.
